# Spider Kelly's

> Neighborhood bar on Wilson Boulevard in Clarendon, Arlington, with pool, shuffleboard, darts, food and drinks. Open late every night.

- Type: Bar
- Address: 3181 Wilson Blvd, Arlington, VA 22201, USA
- Phone: (703) 312-8888

## About
Spider Kelly's was created by Nick Freshman and Nick Langman, lifetime area residents, as a comfortable bar and dining room tied to the neighborhood. It is not a chain, and we want to be a lasting part of this community.
The menu is easy and approachable, but the ingredients are high quality and the preparation is careful. The atmosphere is relaxed and casual, and we stay open late every night. No closing on a whim here.
Our motto is "come as you are," and we mean it. T-shirts or tuxedos, you'll fit right in. Guests have given us a 4 rating across 830 Google reviews.

## Services
- Games and lounge areas: Multiple lounge areas with pool tables, shuffleboard, darts and video games.
- Bar and dining room: A relaxed bar and dining room with an easy, approachable menu made with high quality ingredients.
- Private events: Ask us about hosting your private event.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open late?
A: Yes. The bar is open late every night, and we don't close on a whim.

Q: Can I get there by Metro?
A: Yes. We're two blocks west of the Clarendon Metro stop on the Orange line.

Q: Is there a dress code?
A: Our motto is "come as you are," and the staff takes it literally.
